programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Malham Bridge, eccentric widow Isobel Hewitt and adulterous doctor Duncan Goff are both murdered while fly fishing near the riverbank. DCI Barnaby and DS Troy question if one or the other was the target and whether one just happened to stumble across the other. Many suspects and motives abound, as the detectives try to find out. When another murder takes place, Barnaby deduces that it may have been a distraction to conceal the killer's identity.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The body of Martin Wroath is found in his home in Midsomer Worthy. From first appearances it looks as though he had committed suicide by shotgun. Evidence soon suggests that he was murdered. When a second murder takes place on the grounds of the cottage hospital, the detectives need to uncover any possible connections to link the deaths, as well as the mysteriously disappearing rope.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Joyce joins the local watercolour society for an open-air art class, upon the village green in Midsomer Florey. Shortly before taking a break, she stumbles across the body of elderly Ruth Fairfax, a fellow artist found in the undergrowth. It turns out that she had more to her than meets the eye. When Barnaby is taken off the case by the NIS, it is left to Troy to 'apprehensively' let Barnaby in on what's going on with the investigation.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: At the family home of actor Larry Smith in the village of Upper Warden, a crowd has gathered to watch the promotion for the sequel to his hit film 'The House of Satan', when Larry walks into a summerhouse house in the grounds, it suddenly explodes. His family quickly suggest that it was someone from the rival village of Lower Warden. When Larry's director; another member of his family is also murdered, electrocuted while using an exercise bike.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Magna, the body of a man is found who had apparently drowned himself. It is discovered later that he was desperately seeking a way out of bankruptcy after visiting a local millionaire to get back his money from a scheme he had invested in. The post-mortem says that he was indeed murdered. Whilst DS Troy assists a pretty wildlife liaison officer with an investigation into the illegal sale of protected birds eggs.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a canal restoration project near Midsomer Worthy, on which Joyce is working as a volunteer, several skeletons are discovered shortly after a tunnel collapse. DCI Barnaby begins his investigations when it is found that one skeleton had modern dental work. Meanwhile, DS Troy, having been promoted to Inspector has his last case in Midsomer, to look into the murder of a youth, Simon Mayfield (Henry Cavill), who had caused problems for many in the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DS Dan Scott, a charming young man but with a bit of an urban chip on his shoulder, arrives in Midsomer as DS Troy's replacement. He is instantly involved in his first case, a woman stabbed after attending a Spanish-themed evening in Midsomer Mallow. Not long after, a retired doctor for whom she had worked is murdered during the village's annual garden open day. It quickly becomes clear that the two victims knew a secret about one of the villagers. Are both crimes connected?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Back in 1970, Roger Heldman died in what appeared to be an accident, during a dig at Midsomer Barrow. It unearthed two important Celtic pieces, a spear and chalice. In present day, Roger's son Gareth is killed with the spear, after having altercations with several villagers. At the climax of the summer solstice celebration Gareth's half brother David Heartley-Reade is killed while performing a ceremony to save his failing marriage.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby and DS Scott arrive in Midsomer St. Michael to investigate the apparently accidental death of former prize-winning author Richard Rackham. But it is discovered that he had had his neck expertly broken before his tumble down the stairs. The village's 12th annual Literary festival brings feuding writers, publishers, and editors to town. When Mr Rackham's editor is then found dead during the festival's opening ceremony, it leads police on a trail of deception, fraud, and hidden truths.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village pub of Midsomer Worthy, The Maid in Splendour, is the workplace of many locals. One night, popular barman Jamie Cruickshank is found dead near an abandoned cottage in the woods. The new manager Stephen Bannerman, who is thoroughly disliked by many, wants to sell the Maid to property developers in secret. When Stephen is murdered, Barnaby and Scott have to find out whether Jamie or Stephen was the intended target of the first murder.

programme.desc: Cody's rodeo is fast approaching and time is running out, so the cowboys head out to scout talent for the team-roping event. Misty also comes up with a potential rodeo venue, so Cody heads out to Bay Minette, AL to lock down a site. Bubba and Kaley prepare for houseguest Andrew's family to arrive. Will Andrew finally find his own place, and get out of Kaley's hair? Meanwhile, the guys' reputation as cattle brokers starts to flourish. Booger gets a lead on a healthy herd of cattle in Texas, and the guys consider if they should go all-in and buy the entire herd. Booger heads back to the Lone Star State and strikes a deal that seems to be a win-win. But just as the guys get the ball rolling with another big deal, a phone call from their buyer puts everything in jeopardy.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way

Cody bounces a crazy rodeo idea off the boys - then uses them guinea pigs. Bubba plans a short getaway with Kaley, but there's a big catch: Booger's been tapped as the babysitter, with Jaclyn lending a helping hand. Kaley wonders if Booger is up to the challenge. His first attempts to feed and dress little Andie suggest he most certainly is not! Cody is desperate to find the final missing piece for his rodeo: an announcer. While Booger adamant that he's the perfect man for the job, Cody has to resort to using reverse psychology on his old friend to avoid disaster.

programme.desc: Charlie Russell is an aimless cowhand who loves the freedom of the cowboy way of life, and he is a self-taught artist who enjoys capturing the scenes of his rugged work on the range. Charlie's new bride Nancy gives him the encouragement he needs to stop cowboying in order to focus on his artwork. Under her watchful eye, he sobers up, stops cowboying, and improves his mastery of painting. Nancy is so proud of Charlie's talent that she doesn't hesitate to ask top dollar for his paintings. Russell.

programme.sub-title: Jim Beckwourth: War Chief of the Crow

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Friend is Obsessed with Me
programme.desc: Traci says her former friend, Jinda, is obsessed and infatuated with her. Traci says Jinda began texting her about 50 times a day after they first met -- texts that soon became over-the-top proclamations such as, “I can’t get you out of my mind," and “I swear I will love you the right way.” Traci says she thought Jinda just needed a friend but then grew more uncomfortable as, she claims, Jinda was also inappropriately affectionate with her children, began texting her friends whom she had never met, and even tried to touch and kiss her. Traci claims Jinda crossed the line when she tried to sabotage her marriage, so she cut off communication with her. But is Jinda getting the message? Traci says Jinda still texts and drives by her house, and she worries what Jinda might do next. Jinda admits to being "needy and clingy" but does she see that she's overstepped her boundaries? Can Dr. Phil help her rein in her behavior? Then, Kari says her sister, Holly, stabbed her in the back when she took Kari’s ex-husband’s side during their divorce -- and, after not speaking for three years, she wants an apology. Holly says she’s not sorry and that Kari is the one who needs to apologize. Can Dr. Phil end the silence between these sisters?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to children and sports, many believe there is a huge problem with entitled athletes. Are athletes being coached to believe they are individually more important than their teams and that the rules simply don’t apply to them? Dr. Phil sits down with parents, athletes, coaches, and students who all say yes – but they strongly disagree about who is to blame. A coach claims parents are to blame due to modeling outrageous and entitled behavior. However, the sports parents in Dr. Phil’s audience push back, claiming coaches need to stop blaming them and start blaming themselves. Then, meet a referee who wrote an emotional email to parents informing them he was quitting due to their sideline behavior. And, a former all-American quarterback talks about the dark side of college sports. Plus, ESPN investigative reporter Paula Lavigne reveals some of what she has uncovered.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some people are just unusual. But today unusual means shocking and embarrassing! Dr. Phil’s guest want to know if their eccentric loved ones are worth dealing with. The first guest shops so much she’s stockpiled herself right out of her own home. Her eighty-year-old mother has to deliver newspapers to help pay off her mounting debts! Then—another guest is dating a plumber who likes to wear women’s clothes. She doesn’t know whether to leave him or marry him. Dr. Phil has some straight words for this odd couple.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a gay, drug abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? And is there any truth to her allegations? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he finally break down and take it? And why does Melanie’s daughter, Caylin, support him anyway, regardless of the outcome? Then, Lori says her 17-year-old daughter, Mackenzie, is obsessed with a boy who's already broken up with her four times. Find out why Dr. Phil has a stern message for this mom.

Plus, hear from Trichelle, who faces 20 years in prison after she says she shot and killed her husband in self-defense after years of alleged domestic abuse. Will her words of warning make an impact on Kaitlyn?

programme.title: Dr. Phil

Bailey’s mom, Ericka, says she’s lost her daughter to this fixation she has with this stranger, and she wants her daughter back. When Bailey finds out she will be sharing the stage with her mom, Bailey storms off because she says she hates her mom. Will she come back and talk to Dr. Phil?

Will this be something that poisons you for the rest of your life, or will it be something that you adapt to in a way that you can move on? If you're struggling to overcome a trauma, learn to take back control, stop fueling irrational fears and move forward with your life.

programme.desc: The final act of the Second World War is its most costly episode. More than one million German soldiers die in 1945 alone.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: In the first episode of the three-part series, The Biblical Plagues, scholars deal with the first six natural disasters. In the Nile, scientists discovered deadly microorganisms that caused the fish to die and a stress situation among the frog population.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: For a long time, scientists have tried to prove that nine of the Ten Plagues described in the Old Testament point to a serious breakdown of the climate, triggering an ecological chain reaction. Apart from theological considerations, scholars all over the world have studied individual phenomena, trying to explain the causes of this Biblical disaster.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: Although nine disastrous plagues had already devastated the land along the Nile, Pharaoh remained stubborn and would not release Moses and his people from slavery. And so their God, Yahweh, planned his final assault: At midnight, he sent death over Egypt – all the firstborn, Man or beats, had to die … there was no escape.

programme.title: Monsters and Myths
programme.desc: Monsters have always been part of our nightmares and fairy tales. But where do they actually come from? How much of them is truth, how much is myth? Going to great lengths in this documentary, the filmmakers join scientists to explore a number of the best known sagas and legends in the world.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “... all the waters that were in the river [Nile] were turned to blood. And all the fish that was in the river died,” reports the Bible, “and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river.” (Exodus 7:20–21).

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… so there were lice upon man, and upon beast,” reports the Bible, “all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.” (Exodus 8:18, 17). Even today, two million people die every year from malaria transmitted by mosquitoes, mainly in Africa.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… and the Lord sent thunder and hail, … and fire mingled with the hail,” reports the Old Testament. “And the hail smote … all that was in the field, both man and beast.” (Exodus 9:23–25).

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “... locusts … invaded all Egypt …. They covered all the ground until it was black,” reports the Bible. “They devoured … everything growing in the fields … – nothing green remained on trees or palms in all the lands of Egypt.” (Exodus 10:14–15). Swarms of locusts are still a very real plague today.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… darkness that can be felt … covered all Egypt for three days,” reports the Bible. “No one could see anyone else … for three days.” (Exodus 10:22–23). Dust storms frequently paralyze public life during the storm season in many of the most arid regions of the Earth, burying roads and human settlements, threatening the lives of humans and animals alike.

programme.title: Children of the Wild
programme.desc: In many cultures there are myths about “wolf children” who were taken from their families and then grew up in the wild, either alone or with wolves, bears or other animals. But how close are such stories to reality? This program offers a combination of two stories: the true story of the monkey boy John Ssebunya in Uganda, and that of Rudyard Kipling’s Mowgli, the most famous, albeit fictitious, wolf child of all. Unlike the children in the myths and stories, children who grow up without human beings have massive problems integrating themselves into society. The program specifically follows the fate of the young Ugandan boy John Ssebunya. If there is no human being as communication partner in the first years of a child’s life, the wolf child will yelp, growl, scream or grunt. He is not yet ready to make contact with other children.

programme.title: In Search of Santa Claus
programme.desc: The amazing transformation of a holy man from Turkey into the world-wide symbol of Christmas cheer. He's one of the most widely recognized figures in the world; but what are the origins of St. Nicholas, and how did he become Santa Claus? With criminological acumen, this one-hour documentary sorts the myths from the facts to present the true story of the first multi-national saint, revered by the Catholic, Protestant and Orthodox churches alike.

programme.title: The Secret of the Phaistos Code
programme.desc: Is the Phaistos Disc a clever fake? The film follows the trail of possibly one of the greatest archaeological scandals ever. The search for the truth starts in the ancient Cretan palace complexes of Phaistos. The North American art dealer Jerome Eisenberg, one of the world’s foremost forgery experts, considers the “Phaistos Disc” to be a latter-day fake. In 1908, it was discovered by the Italian archaeologist Luigi Pernier. Since then, the disc has aroused the scientific ambition of countless linguists. The British academic Gareth Owens has analyzed new archaeological discoveries with unfamiliar characters and believes the disc to be genuine. But Eisenberg remains convinced that the disc cannot be deciphered at all. He claims that not only does it not reveal a text that has ever been decipherable, but also that is not even of ancient origin.

programme.title: The Advance of the Hanseatic League
programme.desc: At the bottom of the Baltic Sea lies a cog, a relic of the might of the German Hanse, a league of merchantmen founded about 1200 AD. Archaeologists are retracing its final voyage using state of the art technology as well as ancient scripts. Their search takes them to the Norwegian port of Bergen, to the Shetlands and even as far as Iceland.

programme.title: Expedition in the South Seas
programme.desc: He is one of the greatest German explorers of all time even though his name fell into oblivion: As luck would have it, in 1772 17-year-old Georg Forster was given the chance to accompany the greatest navigator of his time, James Cook, on his world circumnavigation. On this voyage, Captain Cook discovered islands and peoples, while Georg Forster focused on animals and plants, discovering more than 400 species that had been unknown to Europeans until then. “Terra X” follows German actor Robert Atzorn on his search for traces around the world. He gets to know a young man, whose philosophy and conception of the world still appear to be really modern. Sophisticated dramatic reconstructions bring the fateful sea journey to life. The film portrays a great natural scientist whose knowledge and legacy determined patterns for scientific research in the 21st century.

programme.title: The Deadly Treasure of Lake Kivu
programme.desc: In Lake Kivu, on the borders of Rwanda and Congo, there is methane gas worth $25 billion. Enough to supply central Africa’s energy needs for generations. But if it explodes, it will kill up to two and a half million people living on Lake Kivu’s shores. The danger is real.

programme.title: In Search of the Golden Fleece
programme.desc: When Jason and his crew of 50 men set sail, a dangerous journey to what was then known as the end of the world lies ahead of the Greek heroes. The young hero had a one-of-a-kind galley built for the voyage, which he baptized "Argo." The mighty rowing boat was designed to take the committed band to the legendary land of Colchis, beyond the Dardanelles.

programme.title: Wandering Wolves
programme.desc: For most Europeans, the wolf is more of a myth than an actual wild animal. But since the nineties, Isengrim has been making his way back to the middle of the continent, kilometre by painstaking kilometre. Part One of ‘Wandering Wolves’ follows the renowned biologist Francesca Marucco and other experts on the trail of an Italian nomad wolf on his way to the French Maritime Alps.

programme.title: Wandering Wolves
programme.desc: In Part Two of the documentary, the wolf experts Luigi Boitani, Francesca Marucco, Ilka Reinhardt and Hubert Potocnik track the animals all the way across Europe. We see how wolves often cover over a thousand kilometres on their migrations. They swim through fast-flowing rivers and traverse icy mountain ranges and multi-lane motorways.

programme.title: Casanova - the Art of Seduction
programme.desc: Giacomo Casanova was born in Venice in 1725, to poor parents. Initially, he is expected to become a priest, but he is ultimately going to reject this career path. His destiny is governed by the love of women, and he challenges the most powerful institutions of his time: the Catholic Church and the Venetian Inquisition. For Casanova, life in decadent Venice is an on-going feast for the senses.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues

programme.title: The Vietnam War: Unknown Images
programme.desc: As peace negotiations dragged on, U.S. soldiers faced new threats and dangers - and a largely conscript army started to come apart under pressure. Once-censored film footage provides a shocking insight, from the carnage of Hamburger Hill to vicious fighting in the Mekong Delta.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Versailles
programme.sub-title: Louis XIV, The Dream of a King
programme.desc: The life and loves of France's most famous king, Louis XIV. Dubbed the Sun King by his admiring court, Louis conquered half of Europe, conducted dozens of love affairs and dazzled his contemporaries with his lavish entertainments. But perhaps his greatest achievement - and certainly his longest lasting love - was the incredible palace he built at Versailles, one of the wonders of the world.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: The Soviet forces on Germany's eastern border are given a challenge by Stalin.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: June 22, 1941. Under the code name 'Barbarossa', Nazi Germany invaded the Soviet Union. In the first hours of the attack, bombs rained down on Soviet airfields on the frontier, opening the way for the Panzer division and definitely breaking the German-Soviet non-aggression Pact, signed two years earlier. For the Soviets, it was a complete surprise...

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Thanks to the American landing in June 1944, the Allies were certain to end the war before Christmas. This optimism led them to make strategic mistakes, and sometimes to retreat in the face of the Wehrmacht's fierce resistance. When winter came, the enemy may have been weakened, it was far from being dead.

programme.title: World War II: The Sound and the Fury
programme.desc: Germany's invasion of Poland sparks global war. Blitzkrieg crushes France; Britain stands alone. Japan expands across Asia, exploiting colonial weakness. In China, resistance grinds on. Africa becomes a new front. The Battle of Britain marks air power's rise. As old empires falter, total war reshapes the world. A collapsing order gives way to a brutal, modern conflict.

After the American landing in North Africa the Axis armies have no choice but to surrender and put an end to the Desert War on May the 13rd of 1943.

programme.desc: Hitler's visit to occupied Paris; meetings with Mussolini in Berlin and Rome; his first major debut.

programme.desc: The final battle of the war begins as Russian forces advance rapidly into Berlin.

programme.desc: Hitler, Göring, and Himmler shared a strange obsession with animals, using them as propaganda tools, symbols of ideology, and even weapons of war. Through archives, expert insight, and re-enactments, this documentary uncovers how the Nazis exploited nature to serve their brutal vision.

programme.sub-title: Ambassadors in Berlin: The Whistleblowers of WWII
programme.desc: On 30 January 1933, Hitler became chancellor and the Nazis quickly seized state power. Foreign diplomats in Berlin, turned into spies and whistleblowers, witnessed both Nazi infiltration of high society and the exclusion of Jews. Drawing on rare archives, this documentary reveals their warnings about the rise of National Socialism-and how the world ignored them.

programme.desc: As a military leader, Louis XV, was popular and successful, but he led France into the disastrous Seven Year War with Britain. As his Empire dwindled, Louis amused himself with scandalous love affairs, his own private brothel and bedded five sisters from the same aristocratic family. This is a florid and hugely enjoyable saga of sex, war, torture, gluttony, and some truly astonishing wigs.

programme.title: World War II: The Sound and the Fury

programme.title: It's Sew Easy

Then it's a turn to traditional quilting with an easy paper piecing technique from Rebecca Kemp Brent

Fashion designer Angela Wolf gives a professional finish to knit hems and Deb Barcello returns to make a fun and sassy circle skirt.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels

Next, Joe Rotella shares secrets of book binding demonstrating a piano hinge style binding. Then, Stacy Julian makes a treasures theme album with gold glittery elements. Last, Julie uses an electronic cutter to make numerous triangle shapes to embellish a cover for an album.

programme.title: Make It Artsy
programme.desc: Timing is everything! Doing steps in the right order, waiting for a resin to set, letting glue dry -- these are issues we are all aware of. In this episode we look at projects where timing makes the difference. First is a foiling project, where order makes the difference. Then Dina Wakley has a paint technique using rubbing alcohol. Finally, Joe Rotella makes a wine cork shadow box personalized with a favorite sentiment.

programme.title: Off Our Needles

programme.title: Hands On Crafts for Kids
programme.desc: Each plant and creature has a habitat. To capture the freshness of the ocean, Jenny Barnett-Rohrs makes jars inspired by sea glass. For her art project, Candie Cooper looks to the rainforest for ideas. Then, she sponge-paints an animal foot-print rug. Jenny makes a 3-D diorama of animal habitats from paper and foam.

programme.title: Hands On Crafts for Kids
programme.desc: Every day is play time! Challenge your skills with an ice cream cone ball toss game. Design your own indoor miniature golf course with Franz, then put on a show with puppets Jenny shows how to make and decorate. Add some cardboard to the Family Craft Box to create a super mask and make your own superhero figure.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Blogger Andrew Thornton talks about drawing inspiration from your art and turning your hobby into a business. Then, he shares one of his favorite new jewelry making techniques on making decorative end caps using epoxy clay. Katie's Beading Lesson is about using beaded chain for an easy necklace.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.sub-title: In the Eyes of the Artist
programme.desc: Artists see things differently. Our first featured bead type is pierced metal. Then artist Kate Richbourg creates Frida Kahlo inspired ear wires that feature the motifs in her paintings. Next artist Brenda Schweder encases found objects in a Joseph Cornell inspired piece that shows off his iconic style. Tammy Honaman ends the episode with the first of a series of projects highlighting artists' favorite materials. She begins with the art of the chenille stitch and how changing the color and finish changes the design.

programme.title: Scrapbook Soup
programme.desc: Make technology your friend. It's hard to keep up with each and every new trend but you can find your favorites and use them to your advantage. We begin with an awesome page, then it's a project life page with Nancy Nally using instagram photos, and finally a family heirloom with modern techniques but historic info from Paula Nelson-Hart. Great for young family members to get to know their heritage and for older family members to remember and reflect.

programme.title: Make It Artsy
programme.desc: Shake up your art by finding ideas around your house. To start the show host Julie Fei Fan Balzer looks around her kitchen as a resource for collage papers to use for her project. Then Joe Rotella shares a new look at bats -- making a bat house for your yard. The last segment features the first of this season's color studies- the color red, with host Julie Fei Fan Balzer.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Don't you love that feeling when you use up every bit of fabric for a quilt? Tune in as Angela blazes the path to a stash-neutral quilt that leaves no scrap behind.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show

programme.desc: This episode looks at the development of VR content and hardware meant to improve on the ‘reality’ of VR and the latest games featuring novel and exciting virtual worlds.

programme.title: VR 101 S1 - "TV&Film"
programme.desc: The art of moving visuals has long been used to evoke emotion and empathy in the viewer. Film and TV productions are implementing VR to give viewers an immersive experience where it’s just like “being there”.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "ATV Accidents"
programme.desc: ATVs have allowed us to penetrate the wilderness like never before. But they’ve also made the backcountry a bit more dangerous. Laura and Nick rig up some dramatic, high-speed tests to see how accidents happen and what you can do to protect yourself.

programme.title: Suppressed Science S1 - "Alternative Energy Sources"
programme.desc: In this installment, Athena decodes some of the difficulties faced by the scientists & environmentalists looking to fundamentally change our relationship with energy.

programme.title: Suppressed Science S1 - "Theories Of Everything"
programme.desc: Over the centuries, scientific theories have emerged that rival religious cosmology in terms of ambition and scope. But can science ever truly explain everything?

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Magnificent Mixtures"
programme.desc: In this week's experiments we mix up some fireworks made from tin foil, whip up a stinky polymer, and try out an alchemy staple - turning lead into gold.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Up and Atom"
programme.desc: This week's experiments blow open the science behind creating a glowing pickle, how forensic teams extract DNA, and how acids can transform simple household items to their core.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Hot Hot Heat"
programme.desc: This week's experiments investigate how to send secret messages with heat, how a little bit of melted candle wax can turn into a bomb, and why heat is an essential ingredient in cooking an egg.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Explosive Elements"
programme.desc: This week's experiments include recreating a big bang with lithium, the incendiary power of methane, and how a little bit of liquified nitrogen can lend a lot of power to a rocket.

programme.title: Breaking Limits S1 - "Speedskating"

programme.title: World’s Best Electric Cars

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Getting There"

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Orbit"

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Emissaries"

programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family

After a relaxing day by the lake, complete with apple pie and cold beverages, we followed expert advice from Jared to venture back into the heart of nature. programme.title: Best of Morning Footy
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

When a riveting chain of events forces him to face off with psychotic local drug lord Gator Bodine, Broker must retaliate using the fearsome skills he hoped to keep in his past.

programme.title: Gold Coast
programme.sub-title: ENCORE: 2017 Quiksilver Pro Gold Coast | Finals Day
programme.desc: It was an emotional day full of twists and turns, not the least of which was Matt Wilkinson's return to the Final at Snapper for the second straight year. Florence, Medina, Slater and Parkinson made their intentions clear and all wrapped up solid results. Fanning, Smith and Andino will need to do better at the Margaret River event if they hope to stay in touch with the early leaders. The Title chase is officially on, and there are heaps of great stories and moments to look forward to as the Tour moves to West Oz.

programme.title: WSL Inside Pro Surfing
programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing: Rip Curl Pro Bells Beach presented by Bonsoy 2025
programme.desc: Bells Beach on Victoria's South Coast is the longest-running surfing competition and will host the 62st edition this year. Bells is Australian surfing heritage. With the hope of scoring long-period, groomed walls, the surfers will need to display the perfect combination of power, precision, and timing. The biggest surfing legends have had the honor of winning and ringing ‘The Bell' and 2025 will see a hungry new generation vying for the opportunity to cement their names in one of surfing's most prestigious events.

programme.title: WSL Replay
programme.sub-title: REPLAY | All the Action from the Bonsoy Gold Coast Pro presented by GWM 2025
programme.desc: The Championship Tour is Burleigh Bound. The Bonsoy Gold Coast Pro presented by GWM will go down at Burleigh Heads, a location with its own incredible legacy and rich in surfing heritage. This is the second to last stop of the Tour before the Mid-season Cut; every turn, every heat, every wave matters. Relive Final's Day action as the world's best fight to stay on tour and earn critical points in the World Title race.

programme.title: All In: Life on the WSL Championship Tour
programme.sub-title: All In | Julian Wilson's World Title Hopes Edge Closer In France
programme.desc: With only a few days left before the start of the Quiksilver and Roxy Pros, Julian Wilson, Lakey Peterson, Carissa Moore, and Jordy Smith focus on surfing the tricky beachbreak waves of France. For Lakey and Julian, a win in France would mean a solid grasp on the world title. For Jordy and Carissa, the French contests are an opportunity to prove they are the most exciting surfers on the planet.

programme.title: AmeriCarna

More than 50 years after it’s magic at the track, prominent Indy mechanic/owner Chris Paulsen begins to restore the car and Ray talks about the evolution of America’s illustrious Indy 500.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the 1960s, Smokey Yunick, the most innovative mechanic in NASCAR history, sold his famous truck that hauled equipment & cars across the country. Ray is on a mission to uncover this storied truck that helped launch the beginning of NASCAR’s cross-country popularity.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray travels to Long Island, New York with the hopes of learning more about America’s first major auto racing competition. programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Fred Dmuchowski is a New Jersey racing icon. He was a regular workingman who raced on weekends for fun and became a legend in his iconic 303 racer. Ray works to rebuild the 303 in homage to Fred who inspired him to pursue his career in motorsports.

The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

Country superstar Brad Paisley makes a cameo appearance to talk about his prized ‘Vette and the influence of cars on his music.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: AmeriCarna

The original Owens Corning team reunites for the challenge and our crew goes behind the scenes for the Corvette test drive of a lifetime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, like Robin Pemberton and Steve Hmiel.Both cars will hit the track at Martinsville, site of one of the greatest races in modified history and the tragic death of Richie Evans himself. Legends live again, as Ray recreates one of the racing world’s most celebrated rivalries on a track that has seen it all.

programme.title: The Ed Sullivan Show
programme.desc: "The Ed Sullivan Show" is TV's longest-running variety show. It ran on Sunday nights for an amazing 23 years. The show's host, Ed Sullivan, had been a syndicated newspaper columnist who hosted two radio shows before agreeing to try television. On camera, Sullivan always seemed nervous and ill at ease; he couldn't sing or dance, but he knew people who could and signed them to appear each week. Called "Toast of the Town" until 1955, "The Ed Sullivan Show" featured the TV debuts of artists such as Irving Berlin, Hedy Lamarr, Walt Disney, and Fred Astaire and Jane Powell. The format of the show changed very little over the years, with Sullivan presenting acts that tried to please everyone. A typical show might include a few comics, an aria performed by an opera diva, an acrobat and maybe a plug for a new film from a well-known movie star.

programme.title: The Ed Sullivan Show
programme.desc: "The Ed Sullivan Show" is TV's longest-running variety show. It ran on Sunday nights for an amazing 23 years. The show's host, Ed Sullivan, had been a syndicated newspaper columnist who hosted two radio shows before agreeing to try television. On camera, Sullivan always seemed nervous and ill at ease; he couldn't sing or dance, but he knew people who could and signed them to appear each week. Called "Toast of the Town" until 1955, "The Ed Sullivan Show" featured the TV debuts of artists such as Irving Berlin, Hedy Lamarr, Walt Disney, and Fred Astaire and Jane Powell. The format of the show changed very little over the years, with Sullivan presenting acts that tried to please everyone. A typical show might include a few comics, an aria performed by an opera diva, an acrobat and maybe a plug for a new film from a well-known movie star.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E07 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Around the ACL
programme.desc: ATA 201: Signature #2 Preview: Memphis Brackets, Matchups to Watch, and Bold Predictions This week on Around the ACL, Meesh, Trey, and Anthony get you fully set for Signature #2 in Memphis, but first, a special moment to start the show. Commissioner Stacey Moore joins us to send Trey off and make an exciting announcement that sets the tone for what’s ahead in the 2026 season. From there, we break down everything you need to know about the Memphis schedule, including when Pro Doubles, Pro Singles, and Championship matches hit the boards and how to watch all weekend long. We dive deep into the Singles brackets, walking through Brackets A–D and discussing the paths, pressure points, and matchups that could shape the tournament. Who’s got the toughest road? Where could chaos break out? And which players are positioned to make a serious run? Then we shift to Pro Doubles, breaking down all four brackets and talking chemistry, momentum, and which teams look dangerous heading into one of the biggest weekends of the season. We close it out the only way we know how, with fast, bold, and sometimes unhinged predictions in Hole-y Hot Take as Signature #2 gets ready to light up Memphis.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 37: Advertencias, Seduccion y Acusaciones de Infidelidad
programme.desc: En la clínica Aurora intenta advertir a Marisela de lo que acontece con Ricardo y Gabriela viéndose obligada a silenciar su advertencia en vista de lo ocurre con la grave enfermedad de Jesús esperando no convertirse ella y su información en un motivo para causar una nueva preocupación en la sufrida muchacha. Isadora seduce a Gabriel quien sintiéndose torturado por el rechazo de Marisela la acepta el amor de Isadora sin ningún reparo. En la clínica, a pesar de sus esfuerzos y su dedicación hacia Jesús Marisela es victima de las acusaciones de su esposo quien insiste en tacharla de infiel en vista de su romance del pasado con Gabriel Reyes

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 80: Las mentiras de la Miss
programme.desc: Como el que calla otorga, Dileidi entiende que de alguna manera es cierto lo que ella sospecho durante tanto tiempo, cuando el supiera cual era su origen sentiría pena por ella o de igual forma se avergonzaría de su condición humilde, no importa lo decente que pueda ser, ni lo trabajadora, ni lo inteligente, lamentablemente para la muchacha acertó cuando siempre tuvo miedo de que Luis Fernando supiera en realidad quien era ella. Mientras tanto Felicita le cuenta a su mamá que Luis Fernando esta oficialmente empatado con la miss y ahí si es verdad que ella no tiene chance, pues con la cachita o mejor dicho con Dileidi todavía tenía algunas esperanzas de competir, su mamá que parece no escucharla, al final le aconseja que de la batalla, que no puede confiar en nadie, por que la que menos ella piense esa querrá quitarle su marido o en este caso su novio. La Nena habla con Eglee de cómo estuvo la boda de Rómulo y que fue con Doroteo para la misma, que ella tiene que resolver ese asunto con ese hombre, Gladis que como siempre esta en todas partes, escucha y de paso se mete en la conversación, le dice a la Nena que deje de quejarse tanto de Theo, que todos los hombres cojean de una pata y si no que se lo pregunten a ella que tiene un prontuario de eso, que no existe el hombre perfecto, Eglee esta de acuerdo con lo dicho por Gladis. Entre tanto Theo se lamenta con su amigo Gabriel de lo mismo, se siente confundido, pues la Nena pareciera que lo quiere pero al mismo tiempo se avergüenza de el, Gabriel le dice que continué en la lucha, que el sospecha que la Nena esta enamorada, que ellos serán pobres y todo los calificativos que les quieran poner pero que pobres y todo ellos también tiene lo suyo. Los que si tienen lo suyo son Matilde y Ramón, quienes cada vez se aguantan menos, se dicen cosas dulces y por ahí va la cosa, pero cometieron el error de besarse frente la computadora y Pascuita quien estaba conectada en ese momento vio todo a través de su computador, ya no hay dudas, estos se traen algo y parece que es serio, cuando llega Ramón a su casa Pascuita le pregunta de donde viene, el muy tranquilo le responde que de la oficina de donde mas podría venir, ella quisiera matarlo pero domina su rabia y al contrario le recuerda que ella es una mujer enamorada de su marido y que sin el ella se moriría, pareciera que esas palabras causaron remordimiento en Ramón. Los que si no disimulan nada son Matilde y Gonzalo, están cada vez peor, por todo pelean, el de nuevo le dice que ella solo sabe quejarse, no hace sus labores de ama de casa como debiera, los niños se quedaron dormidos sin comer, pero a ella parece que eso no le importa mucho, se pone de inmediato a la defensiva y le dice que entonces busque a Pascuita, Gonzalo no entiende que tiene que ver su vecina con el problema de ellos dos, siempre que el plantea algo, Matilde solo argumenta que Pascuita es mejor esposa que ella, pues la verdad es que si. Dileidi le cuenta a Yenilu la conversación que tuvo con Luis Fernando, su amiga le dice que el la quiere, que de lo contrario entonces para que abría ido hasta allá, Dileidi lo duda por un momento, pero rápidamente deja de pensar de eso modo, pues se le aparece la miss, quien muy generosa le fue hacer una visita de cortesía, y no es otro el motivo sino decirle que Luis Fernando se anda burlando de ella con todo el mundo, que dice que es una vergüenza tener una novia pregonera y en fin le dice cualquier cantidad de mentiras, que en las condiciones en que se encuentra Dileidi, le cree todo, la miss siente que sale victoriosa, ella no es de ese tipo pero cree que en la guerra y el amor todo vale y es por eso que actuó de esa manera con su amiga del alma; con amigas como esa, bueno pues. Lo propio hace Aureliano con Luis Fernando, lo visita con el pretexto de unas maderas para la oficina, pero en realidad el motivo no es otro sino decirle que el tiene algo con Dileidi y que al igual que a el Dileidi le dice novio. Rómulo anda mas despistado en la luna de miel, por todos lados ve a Eglee, se la imagina burlándose de el, ya Betzaida esta muy molesta, y para colmo de males se encuentran con María José en un restauran, a lo que aprovecha Betzaida para decirle que ellos están disfrutando de su luna de miel, por supuesto que la abogada no se esperaba la noticia. Mientras tanto en la casa de Eglee, Cristinita se queja que ahora de podrá ver mas nunca a su papá, Eglee le hace ver la cosa de otra manera y sus hijos se sorprenden al verla tan amplia, después pasan al tema de las diferencias de edades, ellos están de aucerdo en que su padre se haya casado con una mujer menor que el, pero que a su mamá ni se le ocurra hacer lo mismo, pues según ellos se vería mal y hasta ridículo, Eglee no sabe como defenderse, mejor se retira. Nely quiere hacer un viaje con su esposo, quisiera ir a Europa, a Nestor le da lo mismo todo lo que diga su esposa, en cambio quienes si saben conversar son Rosa y José Tadeo, el le cuenta que vio a Nely en la boda, aquella que fue su novia, ella lo toma con el mejor humor. Theo le pide a Gladis que lo ayude, que le diga como era el difunto de la Nena, Gladis le dice que ella jamás ha visto ni siquiera una foto de ese hombre en la casa de su patrona. Matilde habla con la Nena y la trata de convencer de que Theo no es tan malo como ella lo pone, total por lo menos la hace reír no como Gonzalo, a lo que la Nena le pide que le eche el cuento, pero que va Matilde sabe que si abre la boca es mujer muerta y prefiere guardar silencio. Pascuita no se sabe si hablará es Pascuita, quien le dirá a Gonzalo algo muy importante.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 25: El Secreto de la Foto Perdida
programme.desc: Daniela llega al local nocturno para la fiesta de Walter y está nerviosa esperando que llegue Luis, por fin llega en compañía de Inés a quien Walter saluda muy cordialmente. Flavia le reclama a Berta la forma humillante que trató a Marisela, pero Berta se defiende y le dice que en casa a normas que hay que cumplir y si no lo hace se tiene que ir,. Flavia trata de explicarle a Armando la forma tan cruel que Berta ha castigado a Marisela. Flavia con Brígida tratan de calmar a Marisela para que pueda comer, quien poco a poco intenta hacerlo. Marisela a explica a Flavia porque Berta se enojó tanto con ella y le detalla lo sucedido con Emperatriz quien tenía una foto del padre de Reinaldo Núñez y ella la llevó a esa casa.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Abril y Vicenta creen que sus hijos se encuentran cambiados, es por eso que deciden realizarles una prueba de ADN con sus padres. Vicenta se pone nerviosa porque ese hijo no es de Federico, por lo que el ADN nunca dará positivo. Tania, trabajadora de la UDH es asesinada a manos de Ernesto, quien también hiere a Josué. Alejandro logró engañarlo y pegarle un tiro para detenerlo. Josué queda internado y la Pelusa va hacia el hospital, donde tiene una discusión con Ivana, ya que ésta última quiere exclusividad con su hijo. Se lleva a cabo el funeral de Vanesa, en donde Julie le lee unas palabras, expresando su arrepiento y dolor. En este lugar, Julio amanzana a Christian, ya que cree que él es la viuda negra. Sin embargo, Christian niega todo.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 37: El reclamo de amor a Salvador
programme.desc: Socorro se queda impactada con la noticia que le da Mercedes y va a buscar a Salvador para confrontarlo. ¿Cómo así que está enamorado de su madre? Mercedes hace lo mismo por su lado. Socorro encuentra a Salvador herido en medio del campo y lo lleva a la casa. Antes de que lo revise un doctor, Socorro le reclama que esté enamorado de Josefina. Salvador no entiende nada. Momentos después llega Mercedes y le hace el mismo reclamo. Salvador la deja en su sitio diciéndole que no son novios y que él jamás le dirá de quién está enamorado de verdad.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 25: El Secreto de la Foto Perdida
programme.desc: Daniela llega al local nocturno para la fiesta de Walter y está nerviosa esperando que llegue Luis, por fin llega en compañía de Inés a quien Walter saluda muy cordialmente. Flavia le reclama a Berta la forma humillante que trató a Marisela, pero Berta se defiende y le dice que en casa a normas que hay que cumplir y si no lo hace se tiene que ir,. Flavia trata de explicarle a Armando la forma tan cruel que Berta ha castigado a Marisela. Flavia con Brígida tratan de calmar a Marisela para que pueda comer, quien poco a poco intenta hacerlo. Marisela a explica a Flavia porque Berta se enojó tanto con ella y le detalla lo sucedido con Emperatriz quien tenía una foto del padre de Reinaldo Núñez y ella la llevó a esa casa.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Abril y Vicenta creen que sus hijos se encuentran cambiados, es por eso que deciden realizarles una prueba de ADN con sus padres. Vicenta se pone nerviosa porque ese hijo no es de Federico, por lo que el ADN nunca dará positivo. Tania, trabajadora de la UDH es asesinada a manos de Ernesto, quien también hiere a Josué. Alejandro logró engañarlo y pegarle un tiro para detenerlo. Josué queda internado y la Pelusa va hacia el hospital, donde tiene una discusión con Ivana, ya que ésta última quiere exclusividad con su hijo. Se lleva a cabo el funeral de Vanesa, en donde Julie le lee unas palabras, expresando su arrepiento y dolor. En este lugar, Julio amanzana a Christian, ya que cree que él es la viuda negra. Sin embargo, Christian niega todo.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 37: El reclamo de amor a Salvador
programme.desc: Socorro se queda impactada con la noticia que le da Mercedes y va a buscar a Salvador para confrontarlo. ¿Cómo así que está enamorado de su madre? Mercedes hace lo mismo por su lado. Socorro encuentra a Salvador herido en medio del campo y lo lleva a la casa. Antes de que lo revise un doctor, Socorro le reclama que esté enamorado de Josefina. Salvador no entiende nada. Momentos después llega Mercedes y le hace el mismo reclamo. Salvador la deja en su sitio diciéndole que no son novios y que él jamás le dirá de quién está enamorado de verdad.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 37: Advertencias, Seduccion y Acusaciones de Infidelidad
programme.desc: En la clínica Aurora intenta advertir a Marisela de lo que acontece con Ricardo y Gabriela viéndose obligada a silenciar su advertencia en vista de lo ocurre con la grave enfermedad de Jesús esperando no convertirse ella y su información en un motivo para causar una nueva preocupación en la sufrida muchacha. Isadora seduce a Gabriel quien sintiéndose torturado por el rechazo de Marisela la acepta el amor de Isadora sin ningún reparo. En la clínica, a pesar de sus esfuerzos y su dedicación hacia Jesús Marisela es victima de las acusaciones de su esposo quien insiste en tacharla de infiel en vista de su romance del pasado con Gabriel Reyes

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 80: Las mentiras de la Miss
programme.desc: Como el que calla otorga, Dileidi entiende que de alguna manera es cierto lo que ella sospecho durante tanto tiempo, cuando el supiera cual era su origen sentiría pena por ella o de igual forma se avergonzaría de su condición humilde, no importa lo decente que pueda ser, ni lo trabajadora, ni lo inteligente, lamentablemente para la muchacha acertó cuando siempre tuvo miedo de que Luis Fernando supiera en realidad quien era ella. Mientras tanto Felicita le cuenta a su mamá que Luis Fernando esta oficialmente empatado con la miss y ahí si es verdad que ella no tiene chance, pues con la cachita o mejor dicho con Dileidi todavía tenía algunas esperanzas de competir, su mamá que parece no escucharla, al final le aconseja que de la batalla, que no puede confiar en nadie, por que la que menos ella piense esa querrá quitarle su marido o en este caso su novio. La Nena habla con Eglee de cómo estuvo la boda de Rómulo y que fue con Doroteo para la misma, que ella tiene que resolver ese asunto con ese hombre, Gladis que como siempre esta en todas partes, escucha y de paso se mete en la conversación, le dice a la Nena que deje de quejarse tanto de Theo, que todos los hombres cojean de una pata y si no que se lo pregunten a ella que tiene un prontuario de eso, que no existe el hombre perfecto, Eglee esta de acuerdo con lo dicho por Gladis. Entre tanto Theo se lamenta con su amigo Gabriel de lo mismo, se siente confundido, pues la Nena pareciera que lo quiere pero al mismo tiempo se avergüenza de el, Gabriel le dice que continué en la lucha, que el sospecha que la Nena esta enamorada, que ellos serán pobres y todo los calificativos que les quieran poner pero que pobres y todo ellos también tiene lo suyo. Los que si tienen lo suyo son Matilde y Ramón, quienes cada vez se aguantan menos, se dicen cosas dulces y por ahí va la cosa, pero cometieron el error de besarse frente la computadora y Pascuita quien estaba conectada en ese momento vio todo a través de su computador, ya no hay dudas, estos se traen algo y parece que es serio, cuando llega Ramón a su casa Pascuita le pregunta de donde viene, el muy tranquilo le responde que de la oficina de donde mas podría venir, ella quisiera matarlo pero domina su rabia y al contrario le recuerda que ella es una mujer enamorada de su marido y que sin el ella se moriría, pareciera que esas palabras causaron remordimiento en Ramón. Los que si no disimulan nada son Matilde y Gonzalo, están cada vez peor, por todo pelean, el de nuevo le dice que ella solo sabe quejarse, no hace sus labores de ama de casa como debiera, los niños se quedaron dormidos sin comer, pero a ella parece que eso no le importa mucho, se pone de inmediato a la defensiva y le dice que entonces busque a Pascuita, Gonzalo no entiende que tiene que ver su vecina con el problema de ellos dos, siempre que el plantea algo, Matilde solo argumenta que Pascuita es mejor esposa que ella, pues la verdad es que si. Dileidi le cuenta a Yenilu la conversación que tuvo con Luis Fernando, su amiga le dice que el la quiere, que de lo contrario entonces para que abría ido hasta allá, Dileidi lo duda por un momento, pero rápidamente deja de pensar de eso modo, pues se le aparece la miss, quien muy generosa le fue hacer una visita de cortesía, y no es otro el motivo sino decirle que Luis Fernando se anda burlando de ella con todo el mundo, que dice que es una vergüenza tener una novia pregonera y en fin le dice cualquier cantidad de mentiras, que en las condiciones en que se encuentra Dileidi, le cree todo, la miss siente que sale victoriosa, ella no es de ese tipo pero cree que en la guerra y el amor todo vale y es por eso que actuó de esa manera con su amiga del alma; con amigas como esa, bueno pues. Lo propio hace Aureliano con Luis Fernando, lo visita con el pretexto de unas maderas para la oficina, pero en realidad el motivo no es otro sino decirle que el tiene algo con Dileidi y que al igual que a el Dileidi le dice novio. Rómulo anda mas despistado en la luna de miel, por todos lados ve a Eglee, se la imagina burlándose de el, ya Betzaida esta muy molesta, y para colmo de males se encuentran con María José en un restauran, a lo que aprovecha Betzaida para decirle que ellos están disfrutando de su luna de miel, por supuesto que la abogada no se esperaba la noticia. Mientras tanto en la casa de Eglee, Cristinita se queja que ahora de podrá ver mas nunca a su papá, Eglee le hace ver la cosa de otra manera y sus hijos se sorprenden al verla tan amplia, después pasan al tema de las diferencias de edades, ellos están de aucerdo en que su padre se haya casado con una mujer menor que el, pero que a su mamá ni se le ocurra hacer lo mismo, pues según ellos se vería mal y hasta ridículo, Eglee no sabe como defenderse, mejor se retira. Nely quiere hacer un viaje con su esposo, quisiera ir a Europa, a Nestor le da lo mismo todo lo que diga su esposa, en cambio quienes si saben conversar son Rosa y José Tadeo, el le cuenta que vio a Nely en la boda, aquella que fue su novia, ella lo toma con el mejor humor. Theo le pide a Gladis que lo ayude, que le diga como era el difunto de la Nena, Gladis le dice que ella jamás ha visto ni siquiera una foto de ese hombre en la casa de su patrona. Matilde habla con la Nena y la trata de convencer de que Theo no es tan malo como ella lo pone, total por lo menos la hace reír no como Gonzalo, a lo que la Nena le pide que le eche el cuento, pero que va Matilde sabe que si abre la boca es mujer muerta y prefiere guardar silencio. Pascuita no se sabe si hablará es Pascuita, quien le dirá a Gonzalo algo muy importante.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: La viuda Negra toma de rehén a Janet y a otra chica llamada Rosa y le manda un mensaje a la U de H para que Vespasiano elija cuál de las dos muchachas vivirá y cuál debe morir. Ivana está desesperada al saber que sui hija está secuestrada y va a la U de H pero Ángel le recomienda que se calme y vaya a su casa. Inmaculada al enterarse que secuestraran a Janet se pone muy nerviosa y tiene una visión y Salvatore trata de hacerla entrar en razón. Iris le dice a Christian que es una policía y que trabajó durante todo este tiempo de encubierto para averiguar si hubo o no un fraude con las acciones de la fábrica de chocolate y le hace ver que las acciones que este le compró a Inmaculada están en litigio y puede que Christian lo pierda todo.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 38: Josefina Presenta a la Futura Esposa
programme.desc: Mercedes sigue sorprendida al conocer que Josefina sabía que Julio César es el padre de Ramiro. Acepta su juego y le niega todo a Socorro. Julio César e Isabel tienen una fuerte discusión y ella de repente empieza a tener un dolor insoportable en el vientre. Juntos salen rápidamente a la clínica. Manuel le propone a Bárbara que sean novios. Ella acepta feliz, pero ahora no sabe cómo sacarse a Tommy de encima. Julio César sospecha que el amante de su mujer es Salvador. Ella lo niega todo. Josefina llama a Ramiro y le pide que le envíe a la modelo más bella de la agencia. Al gimnasio llega Karen. Josefina llama a Salvador y los presenta diciéndole que ella será su esposa. Salvador queda sorprendido.

programme.title: Episodio 38: Rechazo, un secreto desenmascarado y un juramento.
programme.desc: En la clínica Marisela se ve sorprendida debido a la decisión de Jesús, quien insiste en rechazarla hasta llegar al punto de pedirle el divorcio debido a su postrante enfermedad, Jesús descarga toda su agresividad en contra de Marisela sintiéndose culpable por haberla amarrado a el a largos años de sufrimiento. A su llegada a la clínica, Isadora toma la decisión de desenmascarar la mentira de Ricardo al dejarse llevar por su presentimiento y descubrir al verdadero padre de Ricardo. A pesar del rechazo y las crueles palabras de Jesús Marisela se hace el juramento de jamás abandonar al desvalido hombre. A su llegada al apartamento de Candelaria, Abril es recibida afectuosamente por Gavilán.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Conversamos con Sergio Gutiérrez, actor, guionista y director independiente, sobre sus inicios en la actuación, su pasión por los escenarios y el proceso de construir personajes completos. Con una trayectoria que incluye participaciones en series de televisión, streaming y teatro, Sergio comparte anécdotas de sets masivos, entrenamientos con dobles de riesgo y su paso por producciones como míticas. Reflexionamos sobre la importancia de no juzgar a sus propios personajes, la presencia total en escena, y el valor del capital humano en tiempos de inteligencia artificial. Una charla auténtica y dinámica que revela lo que significa vivir la actuación desde todas sus trincheras.

programme.title: LED LIFESTYLE
programme.desc: En este espisodio nos visitó Liz Guarneros, experta en empleabilidad y desarrollo profesional, sobre las claves para destacar en el mundo laboral actual. Desde consejos para construir un currículum efectivo hasta estrategias para causar una buena impresión en entrevistas, Liz comparte herramientas prácticas que ayudan a mejorar la presencia profesional en un mercado altamente competitivo. La charla aborda temas fundamentales como la importancia de tener una red laboral sólida, la relevancia de las habilidades blandas, el impacto del lenguaje corporal y cómo la inteligencia artificial ya forma parte del proceso de reclutamiento. Además, Liz desmitifica aspectos comunes como el uso de la foto en el CV, el rol de las palabras clave para superar filtros automatizados, y cómo adaptar el discurso al perfil de cada empresa. Con un estilo claro y directo, Liz ofrece tips precisos que van desde el diseño del currículum hasta cómo prepararse mentalmente para una entrevista. Este episodio es una guía esencial para quienes buscan empleo o quieren crecer profesionalmente en un entorno donde conectar, comunicar y presentarse bien marcan la diferencia.

programme.title: LED LIFESTYLE
programme.desc: Conversamos con Fernanda de la Colina, especialista en educación financiera y cofundadora de Zumma, sobre los pilares fundamentales para tener unas finanzas personales sanas, realistas y sostenibles. Con un enfoque accesible y práctico, Fernanda explica conceptos clave como el interés compuesto, el manejo del crédito, las deudas buenas y malas, y la importancia de invertir desde edades tempranas. A través de respuestas rápidas, cápsulas informativas y consejos claros, este episodio busca desmitificar el mundo financiero y empoderar a las personas para tomar mejores decisiones con su dinero. - Este episodio es una guía útil para quienes quieren comenzar a organizar sus finanzas, ahorrar con propósito o entender cómo y por qué invertir, todo desde una mirada fresca, joven y fundamentada.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Conversamos con Jerónimo Best, actor y productor de teatro que ha llevado su carrera a escenarios nacionales e internacionales, incluyendo la Royal Shakespeare Company en Reino Unido. Jerónimo nos comparte sus inicios en el teatro, la emoción de pisar escenarios legendarios y cómo la actuación, en inglés y en español, transforma la manera de sentir y comunicar emociones. Además, Jerónimo reflexiona sobre su labor como productor, traductor y adaptador de proyectos teatrales, así como la importancia de crear equipos actorales que funcionen como una familia. Con humor, sensibilidad y mucha pasión por el oficio, Jerónimo nos invita a mirar el teatro como un espacio donde la ficción detiene el tiempo y nos recuerda el poder de las historias para emocionar, unir y transformar.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: La actriz, productora y activista social Vanessa Bauche nos acompaña para compartir su inspiradora trayectoria artística y personal. Vanessa rememora su autodeterminación desde temprana edad y sus primeros acercamientos al arte y la actuación. A lo largo del programa, reflexiona sobre los prejuicios en la industria, la importancia del teatro, y su activismo social. Desde su icónica participación en “Amores Perros” hasta su reconocimiento internacional, Vanessa habla de su vocación, sus desafíos y aprendizajes. Así como la importancia de la salud mental, la autoaceptación y su filosofía de vida: “La mujer que se tiene a sí misma nunca está sola”. Un recorrido íntimo por la carrera y visión de una de las actrices más reconocidas de México, galardonada con múltiples premios Ariel y aclamada tanto en cine como en teatro.

programme.title: La Bella y el Billonario
programme.desc: Jess descubre la realidad del peligro que enfrenta Mason. Mientras su padre busca un nuevo trabajo, Jess debe lidiar con los rumores acerca de ser la supuesta asistente de Mason. Mason prepara un lanzamiento de producto, pero la presión aumenta por parte de su padre y de la competencia.

programme.title: Boleto A Nashville
programme.desc: Un joven cantante de country sueña con triunfar en Nashville y empieza a salir con una popular animadora, pero ella no comparte su amor por la música. Cuando su carrera despega, debe elegir entre el amor y seguir su destino pase lo que pase.

programme.title: El Legado De Hope
programme.desc: Cuando su abuela le deja el rancho familiar, una joven se anima a entrar en el mundo de la hípica de competición. Sin embargo, con el apoyo de su prometido, su familia y sus vecinos, aprende a tomar las riendas de la vida para hacer realidad sus sueños.

programme.title: Cenicienta en el Caribe
programme.desc: Ashlyn Vanderbilt viaja con su madrastra Miriam y su prometido Bruce para su boda de destino. Aunque Ashlyn encuentra amistad y amor con el hijo de Bruce, Noah, lucha por tener su felices para siempre cuando descubre que su familia adoptiva planea arruinar a Bruce.

programme.title: Amor De Mentira
programme.desc: Cuando Sarah Goldman, una encantadora y joven maestra de escuela en Chicago, quiere complacer a sus padres, se inventa un novio que cree que será el hombre de los sueños de su madre. Cuando sus padres insisten en conocerlo, Sarah contrata a Bob, un actor, para que se haga pasar por su novio.

programme.title: Amor en Aruba
programme.desc: Amber es contratada por Connor, el padre soltero, para que sea la tutora de su hija Macey. Mientras Amber ayuda a Macey, ve destellos de lo que falta en la vida de la familia. Sus grandes destinos están repletos de artículos valiosos y negocios potencialmente gratificantes, pero les falta corazón. La influencia de Amber llena el vacío y une a Macey y Connor. Con eso, Amber comienza a enamorarse de Connor, pero ¿puede él verla como algo más que la ayuda contratada?

programme.title: Fuera Del Menu
programme.desc: Un improbable heredero de una franquicia mexicana de comida rápida se lanza a la caza de la próxima gran novedad culinaria que pueda “tomar prestada”, y se encuentra en un pequeño y polvoriento pueblo de Nuevo México al que acude gente de todas partes para salivar ante las delicias culinarias de una chef local.
